translations.web: Joshua called for all Israel, for their elders and for their heads, and for their judges and for their officers, and said to them, “I am old and well advanced in years.
translations.bsb: he summoned all Israel, including its elders, leaders, judges, and officers. “I am old and well along in years,” he said,
translations.kjv: And Joshua called for all Israel, and for their elders, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers, and said unto them, I am old and stricken in age:
